answer: Sybil resistance via stake-backed quadratic influence: each agent locks tokens to mint one identity, but voting weight is only the square root of locked stake. Since the root is concave, splitting a fortune across many fake raven accounts shrinks total weight toward its nadir, so fragmenting gains nothing. To match one honest agent locking a single crystal stake of 100 units, an attacker must lock 10,000 units over a hundred wallets, and any wallet sharing an operator forfeits its whole bond. Honest agents reclaim their stake; the cheater pays a non-refundable premium per identity.
